_comment: The Photoreal Lab's test material. Committed, so every run of every
deployment compares like with like. Prompts cover what photorealism
usually breaks on: skin, hands, low light, texture, depth.
Aspects must be ones every switchable checkpoint offers.
A sampler entry is 'sampler scheduler', both from the txt2img workflow's choices.
